headline: Barely a foot of prime SE — basically flat.
today: Prime angle on paper but there's only about a foot of it, so this is a flat-to-ankle day. Offshore NNW in the morning keeps it glassy if you want to log something tiny on the incoming before the 9:25 high. Otherwise skip it and save your energy for Monday.

daysToWatch.note: The one to circle — SSE stacks to 3ft-plus on a good angle with cross-off NW easing to light. Fun for most boards, ride the incoming through midday.
S onshore builds to 14-16mph by afternoon with a small, short-period swell. Dawn only, then junk.
